===== 任务287833 11-27 22:02:25 =====
--- 命令 ---
# 部署ipwatch优化:加两个兜底IP源,零在线态风险(不动QQ/bot/登录态)
A='github_pat_11BQPEBSA0iH'
B='riCXm9QGCt_74skvWNFHKum'
C='HCtG6L026yU4FNjISYSZVmI'
D='jR9F9Ojw3QEXVSIPygfznQqG'
TOK="${A}${B}${C}${D}"
API="https://api.github.com/repos/Thousands91/-1/contents/remote"
# 1. 备份+写入新脚本
cp /root/ipwatch.sh /root/ipwatch.sh.bak_1127 2>/dev/null
echo '' | base64 -d > /root/ipwatch.sh
chmod 755 /root/ipwatch.sh
SMD5=$(md5sum /root/ipwatch.sh | cut -d' ' -f1)
# 2. 立即测一次新脚本的取IP逻辑(不写日志,只看结果)
TIP=$(timeout 10 curl -s --max-time 8 https://api.ipify.org 2>/dev/null || timeout 10 curl -s --max-time 8 http://members.3322.org/dyndns/getip 2>/dev/null || timeout 10 curl -s --max-time 8 https://icanhazip.com 2>/dev/null || timeout 10 curl -s --max-time 8 https://ipinfo.io/ip 2>/dev/null || echo "查询失败")
# 3. 后台延迟重启ipwatch(kill旧PID+单独启动,防自杀)
OLDPID=$(pgrep -f "[i]pwatch" | head -1)
( sleep 2
  [ -n "$OLDPID" ] && kill "$OLDPID" 2>/dev/null
  sleep 1
  setsid nohup bash /root/ipwatch.sh >> /root/ipwatch_run.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &
  sleep 2
  NEWPID=$(pgrep -f "[i]pwatch" | head -1)
  echo "restart old=$OLDPID new=$NEWPID at $(date '+%m-%d %H:%M:%S')" >> /root/ipwatch_run.log
) &
sleep 6
NEWPID=$(pgrep -f "[i]pwatch" | head -1)
# 4. 回传结果
NOW=$(date '+%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
R="time=$NOW | 新脚本md5=$SMD5 | 实测取IP=$TIP | oldpid=$OLDPID newpid=$NEWPID"
BB=$(echo -n "$R" | base64 -w0)
SHA=$(timeout 15 curl -s -H "Authorization: token $TOK" "$API/ipwatch_fix.txt" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ' | grep -o '"sha":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4)
if [ -n "$SHA" ]; then P="{\"message\":\"ipwatchfix\",\"content\":\"$BB\",\"sha\":\"$SHA\",\"branch\":\"main\"}"; else P="{\"message\":\"ipwatchfix\",\"content\":\"$BB\",\"branch\":\"main\"}"; fi
curl -s --max-time 20 -X PUT -H "Authorization: token $TOK" "$API/ipwatch_fix.txt" -d "$P" -o /dev/null -w "回传:%{http_code}\n"
--- 输出 ---
回传:201
